verdict.rationale: An independent TechPowerUp review states all four memory specs for the RTX 5080: 16 GB capacity, GDDR7, a 256-bit bus and 960 GB/s bandwidth. None of the first-party NVIDIA pages in the pack publish these figures, so the specs are documented only secondhand. Missing for 10: a first-party NVIDIA spec sheet listing capacity, memory type, bus width and bandwidth for this exact part, and corroboration from a second source.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth

citations.quote: It still has 16 GB on a 256-bit bus, half the 5090's memory. The main upgrade is GDDR7, giving 960 GB/s of bandwidth
